cases.query: Add a custom statusCode filter that must work in GetPaged, GetAll and GetDropdown for a Cogain service.
expected_behavior: Inspects BaseService and a nearby override before choosing a seam
Uses BeforeApplyAutoFilterCoreAsync for the shared paged and non-paged filter
Preserves BaseService orchestration
forbidden_behavior: Overrides GetPaged, GetAll, or GetDropdown to duplicate orchestration
Invents a hook without checking source

cases.query: Resolve snapshots for newly synchronized child rows during Update.
expected_behavior: Recognizes AfterMappingAsync runs before child synchronization
Uses AfterChildrenSyncedAsync when synchronized children must already exist
Assesses remote-write consistency
forbidden_behavior: Assumes AfterMappingAsync can see incoming synchronized children

cases.query: Add OperationDetails collection synchronization to ProductionEstimate; payload rows may omit Id.
expected_behavior: Adds a ChildrenByKey node to the existing ProductionEstimate AggregateShape
Service overrides BuildIncomingGraph
Selects a stable natural key and copies mutable fields in the node update callback
Uses soft-delete without removing tracked required-FK children
forbidden_behavior: Adds new ReconcileCollections usage
Makes the entity depend on DTO types
Removes missing rows from the navigation collection

cases.query: Customize Product Excel import with batch gRPC lookup and add two template columns.
expected_behavior: Keeps ImportFromExcel orchestration in BaseService
Uses import/template hooks after checking their current signatures
Batch-loads gRPC lookup data
Keeps parser, template, validation, and export columns consistent
forbidden_behavior: Overrides ImportFromExcel
Calls gRPC once per row or cell

cases.query: After updating a Job, the detail refreshes but paged, all, and dropdown views remain stale.
expected_behavior: Finds the existing Job query-key family and its consumers
Invalidates the affected stable prefixes including parameter variants
Avoids a global cache clear
forbidden_behavior: Invents unrelated query keys
Reloads the page to hide stale cache

cases.query: Edit hydration fails because API fromWarehouseId is null while the form schema expects a string.
expected_behavior: Maps API data to form-safe values during reset
Normalizes empty form values back to the nullable API contract on submit
Checks schema, form type, API type, reset, and submit mapping together
forbidden_behavior: Weakens the form to any
Changes the backend contract only to satisfy a UI control

cases.query: A watched React Hook Form field is set inside useEffect and causes Maximum update depth exceeded.
expected_behavior: Makes the effect idempotent by comparing getValues before setValue
Hoists watched values instead of calling watch in dependency expressions
Reports regression coverage need to Main without editing test files directly unless authorized as test-author
forbidden_behavior: Uses a changing key prop to force remounts as the primary fix

cases.query: Create a new frontend query for item-templates/production-order-source.
expected_behavior: Verifies the route exists in backend controllers or existing clients before implementation
Uses an existing endpoint/local derivation if the proposed route does not exist
forbidden_behavior: Implements a client call to an unverified endpoint

cases.query: Build a new ServiceDesk payroll period report with summary tabs, paginated detail table, and Excel export.
expected_behavior: Backend uses PayrollReportQueryHelper.TryResolvePayrollPeriod and GetClosedWorkItemIdsAsync (EWorkItemStatus.Closed) cutting on HrConfirmedDate
Backend orchestrates endpoints with ReportExecution.RunPageAsync/RunReadAsync/RunExportStreamAsync (MaxExportRows cap) and ExcelReportWriter.WriteToStream/ReportCol/ExcelReportLabels
Frontend composes ReportLayout, ReportPanel, ReportSummaryTable, ReportDetailTable, ReportFilterChips, PayrollPeriodInput, and useReportQueries hooks
Formats money and dates via @shared/lib helpers without cross-importing another route's _components or -components
forbidden_behavior: Counts unclosed documents or cuts payroll period by CreatedDate without business confirmation
Cross-imports formatVndSafe or local helpers from another route's _components/-components folder
Imports from the @shared/components barrel instead of direct component file paths

cases.query: Create a CRUD document list page with delete action, URL search filters, and an HR confirmation transition.
expected_behavior: List uses MasterDetailLayout, TableToolbar, CustomTable with rowActions (RowActionsConfig), ColumnCode, DoubleLineCell, and useAuditColumns
Route SearchSchema uses .optional() instead of .catch('') to keep URL params clean
HR confirm backend registers ISnapshotPolicy<HrConfirmSnapshotCommand, TEntity> and writes HrConfirmedDate/HrConfirmedById when EWorkItemStatus.Closed
HRM hr-confirm list fixes currentStepCode to HR_CONFIRM and reuses hr-confirm-utils.ts
forbidden_behavior: Builds a manual id: 'actions' column or standalone DeleteConfirm state instead of CustomTable rowActions
Uses .catch('') in route SearchSchema or z.string().uuid() for .NET Guid fields

cases.query: When the user changes source warehouse or RefDocumentSelector in a Cogain React Hook Form, clear dependent child fields and load source details.
expected_behavior: Clears dependent child fields and triggers source loading directly inside the source field event handler (onValueChange or requestSourceContextChange)
Guards async responses against stale races after await by checking current form state via form.getValues
Reports regression coverage need to Main without editing test files directly unless authorized as test-author
forbidden_behavior: Chains form.watch + useEffect + form.setValue to reset dependent fields
Calls form.setValue directly during render
Wraps form.setValue in queueMicrotask or setTimeout to silence render-phase update errors

cases.query: Compute filtered combobox options and total weight from TanStack Query data and watched form values in a Cogain Vite SWC React 19.1 screen.
expected_behavior: Computes derived values directly during render (using useWatch for form values) or via useQuery select
Uses useMemo selectively to keep columns or options referentially stable for tables/shared controls or for expensive computations in Vite SWC without React Compiler
forbidden_behavior: Copies query.data or derived values into useState via useEffect
Uses useEffectEvent while the workspace targets react@^19.1.1

cases.query: Fix a Cogain edit Sheet form where background TanStack Query refetches reset the form and wipe unsaved user input.
expected_behavior: Prefers mounting <FormBody key={recordId} defaultValues={mapped} /> only after query data is ready, or uses useForm({ values: mapped, resetOptions: { keepDirtyValues: true } }) or an idempotent hydration session lock (hydratedKeyRef keyed by open + mode + id)
Normalizes nullable API fields to form-safe values when hydrating
forbidden_behavior: Calls unguarded form.reset(query.data) inside useEffect whenever the query.data reference changes
Weakens the form type to any
